reasoning:
The claim misrepresents the findings of a prominent March 2023 Goldman Sachs report on the economic impact of artificial intelligence. The study estimated that generative AI could expose the equivalent of 300 million full-time jobs worldwide to automation or transformation, not that 300 million jobs would be outright eliminated or replaced. 

The report explicitly emphasized that for most jobs, AI will serve as a complement rather than a substitute, automating specific tasks within occupations rather than replacing entire roles. Stating definitively that generative AI "will replace 300 million jobs" conflates exposure to task automation with full job displacement.
